integrity: A complete proof and a standalone symbolic/finite diagnostic checker are included. Finite tests do not replace the all-order proof. Unresolved specialized historical coverage remains possible.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the rank-three 12-root support modulo N>=5; the even-order face is described by affine equations and positivity inequalities, without extreme-point enumeration. No higher-rank statement. The four-root minimum and root-transform identity are known antecedents.
title: Parity locking and a six-dimensional optimizer face for the finite \(A_3\) Turán problem
